pi-bca10f410f8542c9a69dfe640c129532.description: This document is "Basic Computer Architecture," Version 3.09, by Smruti R. Sarangi, a comprehensive textbook covering computer architecture from fundamental principles like ISA design, bit representation, and assembly languages (SimpleRisc, ARM, x86, RISC-V) through processor design, pipelining, memory systems, multiprocessors, and I/O, with appendices on real processors (ARM, AMD, Intel) and NVIDIA GPUs with CUDA.
